verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's core purpose is AI interaction over the user's own data. Documented paths include RAG that pulls content from local and remote documents into chat answers, @-mentioning files to feed them to the AI as context, in-chat Python execution, and scheduled prompts such as "summarize new files every Monday." Two community users report RAG failing in a no-GPU, external-API-only setup; this is a configuration-specific failure rather than a refutation of the capability, so it lowers confidence instead of making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive or unprompted insights and suggestions (all documented flows are user-prompted or scheduled), and independent corroboration that data analysis works reliably across deployment setups.
